title: E0131: Command execution via proc_open
plain_english: Passing untrusted input to `proc_open()` as part of a command can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary shell commands on the server.
why_matters: Command injection through `proc_open()` can: - Run arbitrary system commands - Read or modify files and databases - Install malware or backdoors - Lead to full server compromise
what_it_checks: `proc_open()` calls where the command string contains tainted input
`proc_open()` calls with user-controlled command arguments without `escapeshellarg()` or `escapeshellcmd()`
